# Index benchmark (generated by src/index_benchmark.py)

Best of 5 runs of EXPLAIN ANALYZE. 'Without' = same transaction after DROP INDEX (or DROP CONSTRAINT for the primary key), then ROLLBACK.

| query | index | with index (ms) | plan | without (ms) | plan | speed-up |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| All laps of one driver (lap_times, 589k rows) | idx_lap_times_driver | 0.96 | Bitmap Heap Scan on lap_times | 1.67 | Bitmap Heap Scan on lap_times | x2 |
| All results of one driver (results, 26k rows) | idx_results_driver | 0.05 | Bitmap Heap Scan on results | 1.17 | Seq Scan on results | x23 |
| Lap times of one race (lap_times primary key race_id, driver_id, lap) | lap_times_pkey | 0.20 | Bitmap Heap Scan on lap_times | 37.99 | Parallel Seq Scan on lap_times | x193 |
